{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies error responses across RPC methods that accept descriptors (including src/rpc/util.cpp and RPC functional tests) to avoid leaking raw secret keys.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "fund safety",
      "rationale": "Prevents leaking private keys and extended private keys (xprvs) in RPC error replies that can end up in application logs or crash reports."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The two-line addition to src/util/bip32.cpp is a minor helper change directly following the descriptor error sanitization.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change touches utility code only incidentally to support descriptor error string formatting."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Updates wallet descriptor import and transaction funding error paths in src/wallet/imports.cpp and src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "fund safety",
      "rationale": "Reduces key compromise risk by stopping wallet import and funding errors from quoting raw WIFs and xprvs into user-facing outputs and logs."
    }
  ],
